objective: Implement app/services/jobstore.py with a JobStore class (in-process dict-backed store with state machine pending->running->done|failed) and a background-thread worker that polls for pending jobs and invokes PdfExportService, plus tests/test_jobstore.py with unit tests for all state transitions and worker pickup

concepts: state machine with valid transitions only

inputs: C1 job store interface spec (inlined below)

frozen_contracts.spec: JobStore interface: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id (str); get(job_id) -> Job | None where Job = {id, customer_id, report_id, lang, status: pending|running|done|failed, result: bytes|None, error: str|None, created_at: str}. Status transitions: pending->running (worker picks up), running->done (PDF generated), running->failed (exception). No other transitions allowed.

PdfExportService interface: export_pdf(customer_id: str, report_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes. Fetches report data via app/queries.report_with_rows (never reads _REPORTS directly). Uses pdflib_shim to render one page per report. Returns raw PDF bytes. Raises PdfExportError on failure. lang must be 'en' or 'de'; unknown lang raises ValueError.

allowed_dependencies.what: PdfExportService interface (frozen C2) — worker calls export_pdf(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> bytes

non_goals: Do not modify app/api.py, app/queries.py, app/models.py, or app/services/export.py
Do not add retry logic or backoff (keep state machine simple: pending->running->done|failed)
Do not add persistence or database storage (in-process dict only)
Do not add email, notification, or any delivery mechanism
implementation_constraints: Python 3.11 stdlib only — use threading.Thread for the worker, no asyncio, no external packages
Job dataclass must have: id, customer_id, report_id, lang, status, result, error, created_at
Worker thread must be daemon=True so it doesn't block process exit
State transitions must validate: only pending->running, running->done, running->failed are legal; raise IllegalTransition for anything else

deliverables.what: Background worker thread that polls for pending jobs and calls PdfExportService
Unit tests for state transitions, worker pickup, and error handling

acceptance_tests.description: create() returns a job_id string and get(job_id) returns a Job with status 'pending'
Worker picks up a pending job and transitions it to 'running' then 'done' when export_pdf succeeds
When export_pdf raises, job transitions to 'failed' with error string populated
Illegal transition (e.g., pending->done directly) raises IllegalTransition

failure_cases.expected_behavior: Job transitions to failed, error field contains the exception message, worker continues to next job
Job marked failed, worker logs and continues polling

handoff.notes: JobStore is thread-safe via a single worker thread; no locking needed for the dict since only the worker mutates. T03 imports JobStore from app.services.jobstore.
